title: Universal Web Scraper Input
description: Extract all data from any webpage.

extractLinks.title: Extract Links
extractLinks.description: Extract all links with href, anchor text, and internal/external flag.

extractImages.title: Extract Images
extractImages.description: Extract all images with src, alt text, dimensions.

extractMeta.title: Extract Meta Tags
extractMeta.description: Extract all meta tags (description, og:title, keywords, etc).

extractHeadings.title: Extract Headings
extractHeadings.description: Extract all h1-h6 headings with their level.

extractTables.title: Extract Tables
extractTables.description: Extract HTML tables as structured data (headers + rows).

extractEmails.title: Extract Emails
extractEmails.description: Find email addresses in the page HTML.

extractPhones.title: Extract Phone Numbers
extractPhones.description: Find phone numbers in the page HTML.

cssSelector.title: CSS Selector
cssSelector.description: Target specific content. Returns matching text in selectedContent field. Example: .product-price, #main-content, article

maxDepth.title: Crawl Depth
maxDepth.description: 0 = scrape listed URLs only. 1+ = follow internal links to that depth.

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum total pages to scrape (including followed links).

usePlaywright.title: Enable JS Rendering (Playwright)
usePlaywright.description: Render JavaScript with a real browser. Required for SPAs (React, Vue, Angular), dynamic content, and sites that load data via JS. Uses more compute than default Cheerio mode.

waitForSelector.title: Wait for Selector
waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting. Only works with Playwright enabled. Example: .product-list, #content-loaded

waitForMs.title: Wait (ms)
waitForMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load before extracting. Only works with Playwright enabled. Useful for lazy-loading content.

extractMarkdown.title: Extract Markdown
extractMarkdown.description: Convert page content to clean Markdown. Strips navigation, footers, and boilerplate when stripBoilerplate is enabled. Ideal for LLM/RAG pipelines.

stripBoilerplate.title: Strip Boilerplate
stripBoilerplate.description: Remove nav, header, footer, sidebar, and ads before markdown conversion. Keeps only main content.

chunkSize.title: Chunk Size (chars)
chunkSize.description: Split markdown into chunks of this size. Each chunk includes section heading, index, and content hash. Set to 0 to disable chunking.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk Overlap (chars)
chunkOverlap.description: Character overlap between consecutive chunks. Prevents losing context at chunk boundaries. Typical: 10-20% of chunk size.

includeGlobs.title: Include URL Patterns
includeGlobs.description: Only follow links matching these glob patterns when crawling. Example: https://example.com/blog/**

excludeGlobs.title: Exclude URL Patterns
excludeGlobs.description: Skip links matching these glob patterns. Example: **/login/**, **/admin/**

proxyUrl.title: Proxy URL
proxyUrl.description: HTTP/SOCKS proxy URL for requests. Format: http://user:pass@host:port or socks5://user:pass@host:port. Use Apify Proxy or your own.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Search Google and scrape the top results. Leave URLs empty to use search mode. Example: 'best project management tools 2026'

searchLimit.title: Search Results Limit
searchLimit.description: Maximum number of search results to scrape (default: 10).

actions.title: Browser Actions (Playwright only)
actions.description: Actions to perform before extraction. Requires Playwright enabled. JSON array. Types: click (selector), fill (selector + value), scroll (pixels), wait (ms), screenshot. Example: [{"type":"click","selector":".load-more"},{"type":"scroll","pixels":2000}]

requestRetries.title: Request Retries
requestRetries.description: Retry transient failures (5xx, network, timeout) this many times before marking the page failed. Permanent failures (404, parse) are not retried.

rotateUserAgent.title: Rotate User-Agent
rotateUserAgent.description: Rotate User-Agent from a real-browser pool (Chrome / Firefox / Safari) per request. Reduces basic anti-bot WAF detection.

cacheEnabled.title: Cache Results (5min TTL)
cacheEnabled.description: Cache page results in-memory keyed by (URL + extract-flags). Same URL within 5 minutes returns cached data with fromCache:true. Useful when the same URLs may appear multiple times in one run (e.g., recursive crawl with shared external pages).

extractMode.title: Extract Mode (LLM-powered structured extraction)
extractMode.description: Switch from plain crawl to LLM-powered structured extraction. The actor crawls each URL, cleans to markdown, and asks an OpenAI-compatible LLM to return ONLY a JSON object matching your schema/prompt. Output is the parsed typed data per URL — not raw markdown. Requires extractJsonSchema or extractPrompt below, plus llmBaseUrl + llmModel (or matching Actor environment variables).

extractJsonSchema.title: Extract: JSON Schema
extractJsonSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the desired typed output. The LLM is instructed to return JSON matching this. Either this or extractPrompt is required when extractMode=true. Example: {"type":"object","properties":{"productName":{"type":"string"},"price":{"type":"number"}},"required":["productName"]}

extractPrompt.title: Extract: Natural-language Instruction
extractPrompt.description: Natural-language extraction instruction (e.g., 'Extract the product name, price, currency, availability'). Used alongside or instead of the JSON schema.

llmBaseUrl.title: LLM Endpoint URL
llmBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions URL. Examples: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, http://your-llm-host:8080/v1/chat/completions. If left blank, the actor reads THECRAWLER_LLM_BASEURL from the Actor environment variables.

llmModel.title: LLM Model
llmModel.description: Model name string the endpoint expects (e.g., gpt-4o-mini, or a .gguf filename for llama.cpp). If blank, reads THECRAWLER_LLM_MODEL env var. The LLM API key (if any) is read from THECRAWLER_LLM_API_KEY Actor env var, never from input — keeps secrets out of run history.

llmTemperature.title: LLM Temperature
llmTemperature.description: Inference temperature as a decimal string ('0', '0.7', '1.0'). 0 is recommended for deterministic extraction. (String editor used because Apify input fields don't natively support floats with custom precision.)

llmMaxTokens.title: LLM Max Output Tokens
llmMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the LLM may return in the JSON response.

llmMarkdownCharLimit.title: Markdown Character Limit Sent to LLM
llmMarkdownCharLimit.description: How much of the page markdown to send to the LLM. Default 30000 chars (≈7.5k tokens). Bigger = more context but slower and more $$ on hosted APIs.
